original_test_intent: Prove the static inventory of physical accelerator module OAM_3 is complete and correct in Redfish and is represented identically in the BMC Web interface.
original_method: Capture the exact OAM_3 member response and a time-aligned OAM_3 Web view, verify module identity first, then compare every expected static property and every unexpected or null field.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies the OAM_3 inventory contract and Web mapping, reviews every mismatch and owns the result.
required_inputs: Approved OAM_3 canonical URI and schema
Expected serial/model/firmware/manufacturer and other static properties
Trusted BMC endpoint plus brokered read-only account
safety_requirements: Verify certificate, BMC and OAM_3 identity
Never transmit or log plaintext credentials
Use only the exact read-only member
Stop on schema, member, trust or Web-time mismatch
Do not omit null or additional properties
agent_execution_scope: Acquire redacted OAM_3 JSON and corresponding UI evidence
Normalize and compare the complete approved property set
Flag absent, extra, null and differing values
Never infer missing values from OAM_0..2 or OAM_4..7 and never set DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Authorize URI, schema, expected map and exclusions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The intended member is identifiable, but disabled trust and embedded secrets invalidate its collection path and a dump alone cannot prove Web parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Perform an authenticated TLS-verified GET of the approved OAM_3 member and compare a complete normalized snapshot to the same module's current Web data and approved baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_3 scope, five-minute attended/machine estimate and Web comparison are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the response to OAM_3 stable identifiers, store redacted raw data, and produce a property-by-property expected/Redfish/Web matrix with capture times.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Repairs transport and endpoint ambiguity and turns an unqualified display into a completeness and parity test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No chassis aggregate or other module response is accepted for OAM_3.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing telemetry, if exposed beside static data, requires an approved sampling rule and is not judged as static inventory.

project_override_considerations: The project must define the exact OAM_3 static contract; the agent cannot treat vendor-specific fields as optional merely because they are absent from a generic schema.
expected_evidence: Approved URI, BMC identity, certificate and versions
OAM_3 stable identity plus full normalized field set
Audit log, redaction review and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The doubled path is a correctable command defect; item, target member and criteria consistently describe OAM_3 static parity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution inputs are project-owned prerequisites; there is no inherent static-review blocker.

review_improvement: Replaces credential-exposing output collection with an identity-bound, complete OAM_3 three-way comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: A response from the wrong OAM can look structurally valid because all eight modules implement the same schema. Stable serial or module identifiers must therefore be checked before property parity. Separately recording absent, null and extra fields prevents firmware drift from disappearing behind a visually abbreviated Web page.
